description.en: Private keys are critical; config, known_hosts and public keys are medium.
description.zh-Hans: 私钥为 critical；config、known_hosts 和公钥为 medium。

description.en: iTerm2 session logs are written to the folder chosen in Profiles → Session → Automatically log; add that folder as a custom path. Shells are not owners: an agent's `zsh -c 'fc -l'` must stay visible.
description.zh-Hans: iTerm2 会话日志写在 Profiles → Session → Automatically log 里选择的文件夹，请把它加为自定义路径。Shell 不算 owner：agent 用 `zsh -c 'fc -l'` 读取历史时必须能被看到。

description.en: Includes Cryptomator / VeraCrypt mounts under /Volumes. Add other mount points here.
description.zh-Hans: 包含挂载在 /Volumes 下的 Cryptomator、VeraCrypt 等解密卷；其他挂载点请自行添加。
